newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police raid huge drugs factory.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police raid huge drugs factory.

text.p: Spanish police said on Friday they had raided one of the largest synthetic drugs laboratories found in Europe and arrested four people.
The laboratory, discovered in a house near Valencia, was capable of producing two million Ecstasy and speed tablets an hour, police said.
"It may well be the largest laboratory found in Europe with such a production capacity," a police spokesman told Reuters.
Police gave no details of drugs seized at the property.
